title: Coupled cluster theory for multireference and open-shell molecules
summary: We introduce a simple coupled cluster approach for multireference and open-shell systems. In the restricted active space coupled cluster framework, the cluster operator only includes excitations from doubly occupied to virtual orbitals, and this ensures the individual operators commute among each other. The ground and excited states are obtained by diagonalisation of the coupled cluster similarity transformed Hamiltonian in a restricted active space.
